text.p: Here are the highlights of stories in the Danish press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
--Scandinavian Airlines System (SAS) first half results exceeded the most optimistic analysts' forecasts.
--Over 90 of the country's most environmentally significant companies face fines if they do not produce environmental reports within the next eight days.
--Hi-fi and TV-maker Bang and Olufsen's first half report showed a rise in profits for the fourth consecutive year.
--If coming first half results from major companies are as positive as those published so far, the Copenhagen stock exchange is set for further gains.

--Houseowners who unknowingly financed purchases through non-convertible bonds during the 1980s may sue for compensation according to a new judge's ruling that estate agents are obliged to explain to clients the type of financing they provide. REUTERS
